discover: Before naming, selecting, recommending, or using a development capability or tool, call jinn_route even when a tool name seems obvious; never infer Jinn tool names from memory. Omit max_tools for adaptive routing. Set include_call=true when arguments are needed. Use ask_user_question for consequential choices. This profile executes no filesystem, shell, state, or network tools.

Set include_call=true for arguments, then use jinn_call with route_id. Use ask_user_question for consequential choices. This profile cannot mutate files, state, or run shell commands.
network: Before naming, selecting, recommending, or using a development capability or tool, call jinn_route even when a tool name seems obvious; never infer Jinn tool names from memory. Set include_call=true for arguments, then use jinn_call with route_id. Use ask_user_question for consequential choices. Web calls may consume quota; mutation and shell execution are unavailable.
